import functools,time
nodecount=0
@functools.lru_cache(None)
def solve_state(covered, counts):
  global nodecount
  nodecount+=1
  if covered==fullmask:
    return () if counts==tuple(capacities) else None
  best=None
  # choose uncovered cell constraints
  rembits=fullmask & ~covered
  while rembits:
    bit=rembits & -rembits; rembits-=bit; cell=bit.bit_length()-1
    opts=[]
    for j in bycell[cell]:
      mask,g,rr,cc=placements[j]
      if counts[g]<capacities[g] and not(mask&covered): opts.append(j)
    if not opts:return None
    if best is None or len(opts)<len(best): best=opts
    if len(best)==1: break
  # choose remaining tile group constraint (needs at least one placement)
  for g,cap in enumerate(capacities):
    if counts[g]<cap:
      opts=[]
      for j in bygroup[g]:
        mask,gg,rr,cc=placements[j]
        if not(mask&covered):opts.append(j)
      if len(opts)<cap-counts[g]: return None
      if best is None or len(opts)<len(best): best=opts
  if not best:return None
  for j in best:
    mask,g,rr,cc=placements[j]
    ccnt=list(counts);ccnt[g]+=1
    ans=solve_state(covered|mask,tuple(ccnt))
    if ans is not None:return (j,)+ans
  return None
start=time.time(); solution=solve_state(0,tuple([0]*len(groups))); time.time()-start,nodecount,solve_state.cache_info()
